summary: Verified Layout Configurator integration with Sauna Calculator. All 5 requested features are working correctly.

issues: Fabric.js console warnings: 'The provided value alphabetical is not a valid enum value of type CanvasTextBaseline' - cosmetic issue from canvas library, does not affect functionality
Console warning: 'Warning: Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for {DialogContent}' - accessibility attribute missing in modal

features_tested.feature: 1. Button 'Otwórz konfigurator' appears after selecting a sauna model
features_tested.verification: Button NOT visible before model selection, VISIBLE after clicking on a sauna model. Button uses data-testid='open-layout-configurator-btn'

features_tested.feature: 2. Clicking 'Otwórz konfigurator' opens modal with configurator
features_tested.verification: Modal opens with role='dialog', shows Layout Configurator canvas and settings panel

features_tested.feature: 3. Configurator auto-selects model and variant from calculator
features_tested.verification: Modal title shows: 'Konfigurator planowek — Sauna Kwadro-Beczka 235x200 cm'. Model dropdown pre-populated. Variant dropdown pre-populated with 'вариант 1 стандарт'

features_tested.feature: 4. Admin features visible: '+ Nowa opcja', 'Kopiuj opcje', edit buttons
features_tested.verification: In Варианты tab: '+ Nowa opcja' button visible, 'Kopiuj opcje do innego modelu' button visible, Options list shows edit/copy/delete icons for each option
Clicking X button (svg.lucide-x) closes modal, dialog role no longer visible

critical_code_review_comments: Line 565-594 in SaunaCalculator.jsx: Correct conditional rendering of 'Otwórz konfigurator' button based on formData.selectedModel
Line 659-699: Modal implementation uses Dialog from ui/dialog with Suspense for lazy-loaded LayoutConfiguratorPage
Line 689-693: Props correctly passed to LayoutConfiguratorPage: isAdminMode={isAdmin()}, initialModelId={formData.selectedModel}, initialVariantId={formData.selectedModelVariant}
Line 319-337 in LayoutConfiguratorPage.jsx: useEffect correctly applies initialModelId and initialVariantId from props when saunaModels are loaded
seed_data_creation: None - used existing TEST_Strona wejścia option from previous tests
context_for_next_testing_agent: Integration between SaunaCalculator and LayoutConfiguratorPage is working correctly. The configurator opens in modal mode with isModal=true prop, auto-selects the model/variant from calculator, and shows admin controls when logged in as admin. Fabric.js canvas warnings are cosmetic and do not affect functionality.
